EmailTemplate.name: Congrats! Here's what to expect next...
EmailTemplate.subject: Congrats! Here's what to expect next...
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi {!Contact.FirstName},
Congrats on moving forward with your passive income plan!
Our next step is going to be assisting you through the entire closing process.
*An email from Memphis Invest will be sending you over your contract via docusign. Please take time and review and direct any and all questions back to me so that I can help you get that back in within 3 days or it will expire and the property will be released.
*If you are financing in any way we will then make sure the executed contract gets over to the lender you will be using.
*After we receive your executed contract, you will be called once a week to let you know what next steps you will need to take. This will include
Setting up insurance. Facilitating the closing process between the insurance provider, closing agent and lender. Making sure that you have all of the before and after pictures of the property.
Your contact person other than myself during this closing process will be:
Taylor Streitmatter Closing Department 130 Timber Creek Cordova, TN 38018 ​P: 901-505-0728 F: 901-751-7187 E: taylors@memphisinvest.com​
**After closing** You will be introduced to a customer service representative. They will be calling you weekly the first 4 weeks, then monthly as long as you are a client of ours. They will be your go-to person for any and all questions you may have regarding the management of your asset.
I am looking forward to assisting you in anyway I can throughout the entire process as well. Please feel free to reach out to me at anytime.
To Your Success-
Ashley Claunch Sr. Portfolio Advisor, MemphisInvest.com Tel: 901.751.7191 Direct: 901.505.0723
